name: dashboard
title: Dashboard shell
description: Signed-in app area: sidebar + topbar layout, nav from site.config, overview with widget and topbar slots for other modules.

dashboard-widgets.description: Cards on the dashboard overview (plan, team, notifications …). Server components.

dashboard-topbar.description: Items in the app top bar (team switcher, notifications …). Server components.

postInstall: Build your app under src/app/(app)/: every page there gets the shell and requires a session.
Add sidebar links in site.config.ts → nav.dashboard (icon names from lucide, e.g. "bar-chart-3").
